[SWS_DM_00243]
Aging
-related
UDS DTC status byte
processing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04140
⌈
If a DTC is aged, the DM shall set the following
UDS DTC status bits
to 0:
• ’confirmedDTC’ unconditionally
• ’testFailedSinceLastClear’ conditionally, if
statusBitHandlingTest-
FailedSinceLastClear
is set to
statusBitAgingAndDisplacement
⌋
After DTC -
Aging
all event related data for this DTC is cleared. If an event mapped to
this DTC fails again a new event memory entry with initial values is created.
